candidates.name: Antenna phase centre offsets
verified_facts: GNSS baselines are measured between antenna phase centres and require vertical offsets to relate observations to physical station markers.
OS states correct phase-centre offsets are important when different antenna types are used.
For the highest geodetic accuracy, especially height, phase-centre variation should also be modelled.
semantic_limits: Unmodelled antenna offsets are an independent GNSS height error source and cannot be assumed to cancel against LiDAR or OSGM15 errors.

candidates.name: Geodesy and positioning
verified_facts: OS Net provides access to ETRS89.
OSTN15 defines/provides access to OSGB36 British National Grid through ETRS89.
The Fundamental Bench Mark network defines Ordnance Datum Newlyn on mainland Great Britain.
OSGM15 provides access to ODN and other height datums via ETRS89.
semantic_limits: The horizontal reference frame, grid transformation, physical height datum and geoid correction are separate components; parcel height evidence must preserve the complete reference lineage.
